subject.title: refactor: canonicalize correctness-critical UI and channel contracts

question: Should this umbrella stay open for staged human-reviewed PRs, and which contract slice should be promoted first?
rationale: The issue is protected by a maintainer label and spans security-sensitive status projection, gateway protocol ownership, and plugin/UI model boundaries, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape or bundle the work.

options.title: Keep umbrella and stage PRs
options.body: Leave this issue open and require separate owner-reviewed PRs for channel status, Workboard, and Control UI gateway contracts.

options.title: Promote one slice now
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly promote the channel-status or Workboard slice as a bounded repair job with this issue as context.

options.title: Split into narrower issues
options.body: Maintainers can replace this umbrella with separate issue trackers if parallel ownership or milestone planning would be clearer.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella and stage PRs
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open and require separate owner-reviewed PRs for channel status, Workboard, and Control UI gateway contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa owns the current issue text, assignment, and proposed dependency order.
